reviews.title: Wish i knew about these sooner!
reviews.body: My existing hot tub cover has a lot of wear on it. I was on the verge of buying a new cover and then noticed this option. Hopefully, this will extend the life of my old cover.The item appears to be thick, very durable and great quality. I measured my hot tub and ordered the correct size. It fits perfectly with a little extra room, which is nice. It makes it easy to install.The appears to be waterproof. I have checked under it after some heavy rains and the existing cover was dry. It is performing as it should.The autumn is very easy to clean. You can sweep it off with a broom. However, I normally just use the leaf blower and blow debris off.This was a great value at around 50 bucks. Whenever I do get a new hot tub cover, I will also be purchasing a new one of these.

reviews.title: Great product. Good value.
reviews.body: This has been great!  Fits my cover perfectly. The sides are deep enough that I never have to worry about cinching it down or latching the underlying hard cover - it just stays on no matter the 60mph gusts we get in the spring. I've had it since April, and it’s starting to fade in the sun, but that’s why I bought it - to protect my $700 hard cover with a $50 cover cap. It’s been easy to use. No regrets. I’ll buy another from this seller when the sun chews this up in a few years.

reviews.author: Dabling

reviews.title: Good fit
reviews.body: This fit our hot tub, with a little left over on the edges. You can really cinch it down tight so the wind doesn’t blow it off. We bought this to extend the life of a new ($600) cover. Water does bead up and roll off if there is enough pitch. There is a slight slope on our cover, but the water does not always roll off. If not, it will soak into the cover and just be wet. We try to go out and clean it off after significant rain or snow.This cover is easy to remove and provides protection from debris and snow, but as I said, it can retain water.The material is thick and feels to be of good quality. I just wish it would not retain water.Update:I just took the cover off to add chemicals. You can see there is water between the cloth cover and the hot tub cover. It will at least keep the ice and snow from scraping across the new cover, but it is not waterproof.Update: we have had the cover for almost a year. We got it to extend the life of a new cover from the manufacturer. It is faded from the sun, and it appears it is still somewhat water resistant. We are still hoping it prolongs the life of our new $600 cover!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 5, 2024

reviews.body: Our cover was ripping due to age and weather.  A new full cover was going to vost +$600. This cover was the perfect option. Doesn't look as nice as a new $600 cover, but doesn't look bad either. Highly recommend

reviews.title: Sacrificial spa cover
reviews.body: Ok so here's my thoughts. I read so many others that rate it bad. Listen, this is not a jacuzzi cover. This is a sacrificial jacuzzi cover/cover to save your jacuzzi real cover that was a $900 investment covering your spa.Ok so I'll explain my situation.I live in Houston Texas, basically the middle of Hell. Our summers here are around 110. With your regular expensive spa cover in this heat it will only last a couple of years at the most. What this cover is for is to put over your regular expensive spa cover so the sun and weather beats down on it and not your expensive cover. These will then save you from buying the $900 cover every couple of years.This cover is your sacrificial cover, it saves your thick expensive cover, this cover will last a couple years in this heat, then toss it and buy another one. And your good to stay good as good as new for a very long time.In the mean time you paid around $40 every couple of years but you saved $900.Ok, my rating on this cover: is its pretty good, yes water does sweat thru but my other cover Sheds it off and keeps looking like new. I'll be glad to get a couple of years out of it, I'm thinking probably 3yrs. I like it, fits great. It has 1 motorcycle helmet type pull strap and 2 pull tight draw strings with hold tight holders on them. Good material. It's a good buy.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 20, 2023

reviews.title: We Love Our Uceder Optimum Spa Cover
reviews.body: Couldn't Be Happier With This Uceder Patio Cover. We Purchased It For Our Older Catalina Spa That Measures 83 " x 83". This Uceder Cover Measures 84" x 84" And Fits Amazingly Well.(We Also Purchased A Blue 84"x 84" Cut To Fit Bubble Wrap Style Water Cover And Our Tub Easily Stays At 104 F Degrees Easily.)Last Year We Stopped Using Our Spa Because It Was Supposedly Was Leaking Water.  Even Had It Looked At By A Spa Repairman Who Said It Could Cost Hundreds To Repair A Leak That Wasn't There.I Discovered It Wasn't The Spa At All. It Was A Worn Out Standard  Foam Cover That Was Collecting Water And Releasing On The Sides. A New Spa Cover Was Going To Run Over $500 Plus Tax.This Uceder Spa Cover Fits Our Needs Perfectly.  It's Well Made With 600 D Heavy Duty Material That Is Plastic Lined On The Interior Side With The Outer Side Like A Canvas Feel.  It Has Straps To Help With With Fitment.We Did Get The Blue Bubble Material That Floats On The Water That You Can Cut To Fit Which Also Helps Retain The Heat.The Combined Purchased  Cost Well Less Than $100 And Fits Our Needs Better Than Had We Spent Over $500.My Wife And I Are Both Seniors And Find These Options Much Easier To Handle Than Even The Standard Hot Tub Foam Covers With Lifts.We Are Happy Customers!

reviews.title: Works great, a good investment to protect the expensive insulated cover!!!
reviews.body: I live in Colorado.  Our sun is intense!  My hot tub sits in full sun.  The UVs chewed up my insulated cover so I decided to try this to extend its life, and now protect my new insulted cover.  It's perfect for the job.  Completely waterproof and quite durable.  2.5 years in it has a few tears in it from the sun but it is saving me many 100s by extending the live of the very expensive insulated cover.  I'm using duct tape to keep it going for now but when it's completely done I will absolute replace it with another one.  Totally worth $60 to protect $800.  I highly recommend it!Side note, when we get our gale force winds it has blown off a couple of times even with the strap tightened.  Not the fault of bad design, just inevitable in a high wind.  Always lock down your main cover with clips!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 23, 2026
